name: Family Holiday Movie at Shannon Staub Library
ages: All ages, from babies to teens
paras: Sarasota County Libraries invites families to watch a holiday movie together on Monday, December 21, 2026, from 10:30 AM to 12:30 PM in the Meeting Room at the Shannon Staub Library in North Port.
The library's calendar tags the screening for every age group, from babies, toddlers and preschoolers through children, tweens, teens and families.
The listing is filed under the Cultural Life, Lifelong Learning and Movies program types, and the library's description says to come watch a holiday movie with the whole family.
tip: Arrive by 10:30 AM, when the screening starts in the Meeting Room.

name: Make a Festive Button at North Port Library
paras: The Creation Station at the North Port Library offers a drop in craft on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 1 to 4 PM. Visitors make a festive button for the holidays.
The county library calendar files the activity under Creation Station and marks it for all ages, so kids and grown ups can make buttons at the same table.
Questions go to the library system at 941-861-1110.
tip: Come any time between 1 and 4 PM, since the activity runs for three hours.
